control_plane_policy: Studio is a ChatGPT host adapter only; the pinned official skills/ppt-master Harness owns PPT routing, workflow, gates, templates, images, motion, recovery semantics and QA.
project_router_policy: Project Instructions contain only the minimal PPT-to-Studio routing contract and point to studio/host/chatgpt/ENTRYPOINT.md.
lazy_load_policy: Load only the current host entry/runtime authority and explicitly triggered supporting files; do not preload duplicate Studio workflow policy.
runtime_bundle_policy: commit-bound whitelist containing official skills/ppt-master plus only the minimal ChatGPT bootstrap/recovery adapters and Cloudflare Hosted official-UI runtime bridges; experimental mini-app/static UI implementations remain repository history but are not shipped in the default runtime
human_confirmation_fallback_policy: confirmation-surface failure may change transport but never decision ownership; unless explicitly delegated, chat fallback must present the unresolved official Gate items and wait for explicit user confirmation or revision before persistence and continuation
hosted_ui_policy: when available, ChatGPT uses Cloudflare only as a remote transport for the pinned official Confirm UI and official SVG Editor frontends; Hosted capture never becomes Harness validation by itself
hosted_confirm_policy: Stage 1 and Stage 2 use the official Confirm UI frontend; captured /api/confirm payloads are replayed through the pinned local official Confirm UI server so it owns validation and receipt generation
hosted_editor_policy: Executor Live Preview and deck review use the official SVG Editor frontend; Cloudflare mirrors project SVG/assets and captures edits while the pinned local official SVG Editor server remains the filesystem mutation authority
hosted_ui_immutable_worker_policy: each stable commit deploys an immutable Cloudflare Worker derived from the pinned 40-hex Harness commit so resumed projects do not silently use newer official frontend assets
hosted_confirm_networkless_policy: when execution-container outbound HTTPS is unavailable, Stage 1/2 may use the compact gzip browser handoff plus host-native Web GET capture retrieval; this does not weaken local official receipt validation
hosted_editor_network_policy: remote SVG Editor project synchronization requires actual Runtime outbound HTTPS; if unavailable, do not claim the Hosted Editor is synchronized and preserve the official local Live Preview/fallback semantics
mini_app_transport_policy: Interactive Code Block mini-app transport is frozen as an experimental non-default path; it must not replace the Hosted official UI transport and must never redefine an official Gate schema or assume an undocumented Preview callback
stage1_mini_app_policy: Stage 1 mini-app code is retained only as historical/experimental fallback source and is not part of the default v3.4.0 Runtime bundle
